name: Sebastian Madera
bio:
Sebastian Madera is a renowned tattoo artist based in Milan, Italy, who is particularly lauded for his exceptional skill in creating intricate geometric, tribal, and traditional designs. As one of the region's most skilled tattooists, Sebastian's attention to detail and artistry positions him at the forefront of the craft, ensuring each client walks away with a stunning, one-of-a-kind piece of body art. His dedicated clientele often praises the sophistication and precision of his work, highlighting how Sebastian's talent transforms their ideas into striking tattoos.
Price: $
Current location: Milan, Lombardy, Italy
